court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sunil Pandurang Mantri vs Maharashtra Savings And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Maharashtra Savings and Mantri Realty Limited

facts_of_case: Sunil Pandurang Mantri is the applicant. Maharashtra Savings and Mantri Realty Limited are the respondents.

legal_principles.principle: A dignified citizen respectful to the orders of this Court should not travel abroad without permission.
legal_principles.held: Although no passport is required to visit Nepal, however, as a dignified citizen respectful to the orders of this Court, this Application has been preferred.
cited_cases: Sunil Pandurang Mantri vs Maharashtra Savings And Anr (2022)

legal_principles.principle: A person who is restrained from leaving the country by a court order should not travel abroad without permission.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, all the Directors of the Company and Shri Sunil Mantri are hereby restrained from leaving the country until further orders.
cited_cases: Sunil Pandurang Mantri vs Maharashtra Savings And Anr (2022)

legal_principles.principle: A person who owes money to others should not be allowed to travel abroad without providing sufficient security.
legal_principles.held: He submits that his client is willing to give any security for his return to India.
cited_cases: Sunil Pandurang Mantri vs Maharashtra Savings And Anr (2022)

legal_principles.principle: A person who is willing to provide sufficient security for their return should be allowed to travel abroad.
legal_principles.held: He submits that the Applicant is willing to deposit the passport of his aged parents as a security for his return to India.
cited_cases: Sunil Pandurang Mantri vs Maharashtra Savings And Anr (2022)
